app.title: DevLog
app.subtitle: Time spent building, one repository at a time.
language.label: Language
language.name: English
report.empty: No tracked time in this period. Start a task with dl start.
report.chart_unavailable: The chart could not load. Open a Daily Task Report to view recorded tasks.
cli.description: Track time spent working in Git repositories.
cli.start_help: Start or resume this repository's task.
cli.commit_help: Stage all changes, commit, finish the task, and push.
cli.publish_help: Run this repository's release script without changing the timer.
cli.record_help: Record an existing commit after a tracking failure; do not commit or push again.
error.no_task: This repository has no unfinished task. Run dl start first.
error.task_conflict: The task changed during the operation. No task was completed.
error.unavailable: The operation could not be completed. Check the DevLog service and its log.
error.bad_report: Use valid dates, an existing repository, and a range of at most 366 days.
error.recovery: Local commit {commit_sha} exists, but recording its task was not confirmed. Once the service is available, run dl commit --record {commit_sha}. Do not create another commit to retry tracking.
error.publish_missing: No release script found. Expected new_release.sh, scripts/new_release.sh, or scripts/new-release.sh.
error.not_repository: Run dl inside a Git repository.
error.invalid_remote: Configure a GitHub origin remote for this repository.
error.commit_message: Provide a nonempty commit message of at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.
error.commit_arguments: Provide either a commit message or --record SHA.
error.request_timeout: DevLog request timed out; its outcome may be unknown. No automatic retry was made.
error.transport_failed: DevLog ZMQ transport failed. Check the configured endpoint and service.
error.invalid_response: The service returned an invalid response.
history.pause_help: Enter the break to exclude from this active interval. Leave Work resumed blank to pause through the interval's end. Saving removes these hours from the reports and preserves the task's commit.
history.time_format: Times use {timezone}. Enter pause times as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm, for example 2026-10-24 22:30. For a repeated daylight-saving time, include a UTC offset such as -04:00.
history.pause_saved: Pause saved. Task hours and report totals have been recalculated.
history.open_interval: This interval is still running. Use dl pause before correcting it.
error.bad_pause: The pause must begin before work resumes, and both times must lie within the selected active interval.
error.pause_conflict: This active interval changed or is still running. Reload the task and select a closed interval before inserting a pause.
error.bad_time: Enter a valid date and time as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm, for example 2026-10-24 22:30. For a repeated or skipped daylight-saving time, include an explicit UTC offset, such as -04:00.
error.bad_edit: Provide one active interval, a pause start time, and an optional resume time.
error.edit_origin: Open the DevLog task page on this server to save timing changes.
history.timing_help: Select a work range, then drag it or resize its edges to save a correction. For precise keyboard editing, choose a part and edit its UTC start and end below, then Save timing or Cancel. Work cannot extend past the fixed completion time or overlap other tasks. Pan or zoom to inspect the timeline.
history.timing_saved: Timing saved. Task hours and report totals have been recalculated.
history.timing_unconfirmed: Saving could not be confirmed; the change may already have been saved. Review the recorded timing before trying again.
history.timing_no_script: Enable JavaScript to adjust timing. Recorded intervals are shown below.
error.bad_timing: Keep work intervals in order, with each start before its end. Work cannot extend past the recorded completion time or the time when the page loaded.
error.timing_conflict: The task timing changed or the task is unfinished. Reload the task before editing its completed work intervals.
error.timing_overlap: These work times overlap another task. Adjust the boundaries or reload to see the latest recorded work.
history.timing_timezone: Timeline and precise fields use UTC. Recorded intervals use {timezone}.
history.timing_load_error: The timeline could not load. Reload the page with access to unpkg.com to edit timing. Recorded intervals are available below.
history.timing_refreshed: Recorded timing refreshed. Review it before making another correction.
history.timing_reload_required: Recorded timing could not be refreshed. Reload the task before editing.
